answer: Random peer audit stops a tide of fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks three auditors to replay one agent's work; any delta between claimed and recorded output burns its $40 bond, locked 12 epochs. A jade seal marks agents passing five audits; only sealed agents may audit. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 in bonds, all lost on the first failed audit. An honest agent pays $40 once, keeps its seal, and earns $12 per epoch.
